text_time_distribution_empty: No usage data yet. Start a chat to generate your time-of-day activity breakdown.
chart_daily_no_detail: Only the total count is available for today. No hourly breakdown.
modal_no_timestamps: Only the total count was saved for this date. No timestamp details.
desc_midnight: Your activity typically peaks during late-night hours.
desc_morning: You tend to be active early in the morning.
desc_forenoon: Your usage increases through the morning hours.
desc_afternoon: You show steady activity during the afternoon.
desc_evening: You’re most active in the early evening.
desc_night: Your activity continues into late night hours.
u_intro: Your activity, unchanged. Open Usage for membership and allowance details.
u_subtitle: Keep account allowances separate from activity on this browser.
u_manual: Manual preset · does not change your subscription
u_scope_missing: Membership not identified yet. Refresh ChatGPT once, then try again.
u_failed: Some data is unavailable. Expand Diagnostics for details.
u_reload: The page connection is unavailable. Retry to read your account allowance automatically.
u_no_tab: Refresh to read your current signed-in account allowance automatically.
u_wham_note: Not the Pro Chat message allowance.
u_feature_note: Read only when the ChatGPT page returns them.
u_no_features: No feature counter returned yet. Missing data does not mean zero or unlimited.
u_no_wham: No server usage available yet. Refresh from a signed-in ChatGPT tab.
u_no_pro: This preset does not include Pro Chat. Other features have separate limits.
u_managed: No universal allowance is assumed. Select the correct seat or check your workspace settings.
u_pick_plan: Connect for auto-detection or choose a membership preset.
u_unbased: Tracking locally. Sync your current balance in Advanced settings if you want an estimated remaining count.
u_expired: The saved reset time has passed. Recalibrate; no automatic reset is assumed.
u_credit_note: Endpoint balance only; not necessarily the full workspace billing balance.
u_calibrate_note: Enter the remaining messages and the next reset time you know from ChatGPT. This changes the local estimate only, never OpenAI’s quota.
u_invalid: Enter valid remaining messages and a future reset time.
u_cal_disabled: Choose a plan with a fixed Pro allowance first.
u_diag_note: Internal endpoints can change. An HTTP error is not a quota balance.
u_copied: Copied. No tokens or conversation content included.
u_privacy: No chat text, passwords or tokens stored. No developer server.
u_businessnote: Seat type not confirmed; Standard is not assumed.
u_import_note: Import adds historical activity, not historical model quotas.
u_data_note: Local events are not billing records; unsupported transports can be missed.
u_imported: Activity merged locally. Timestamps are deduplicated; count-only records use the larger total.
u_import_error: Could not import this activity backup.
u_model_empty: No model-aware messages recorded for this workspace yet.
u_timezone: Daily / weekly activity uses your local timezone.
first_reload: Reload this ChatGPT tab once to finish setup.
first_manual_plan: Using a manual plan override from Dashboard settings.
first_reloaded: ChatGPT reloaded. Reopen this popup in a moment.
u_plan_override_note: Normally this is detected automatically. Only override it if the detected plan is wrong.
u_sync_pro_note: If ChatGPT shows your current Pro balance, enter it here once. We will count new Pro messages locally from that point forward.
refresh_failed: Refresh did not complete. Your last reading is preserved; please retry.
release_local_desc: Activity stays local. Usage is read from your signed-in ChatGPT session.
release_plan_note: Used only to apply the published Pro allowance rules. Stored on this device.
release_pro_note: Locally tracked usage. Sync your current balance once if you want an estimated remaining count.
release_no_text: Only timestamps and model labels are stored; chat text is not stored.
release_privacy: Local-only: no chat text, passwords, cookies or tokens are stored or sent to a developer server.
release_local_only: Local activity and read-only server usage.
release_pick_once: Choose your plan once to enable local Pro estimates.
release_no_pro: No Pro allowance preset for this plan
release_estimated_local: Estimated from your sync + local sends.
popup_dashboard_subtitle: View detailed insights, history, and settings
popup_tagline: Smarter tools for a brighter you.
detect_membership: Open a signed-in ChatGPT tab to detect your membership.
local_sync: Local tracking only · sync once for remaining
trend_note: Local messages by day — history, not a duplicate of the popup.
period_empty: No activity recorded in this period.
context_note: A quick interpretation of your current activity.
pages_note: Dashboard pages now have distinct jobs.
activity_note: Long-term usage patterns, streaks, daily movement and time-of-day behavior.
pro_note: Automatic when ChatGPT exposes allowance data; otherwise only confirmed local Pro sends are shown.
recent_pro_note: Observed locally during the last 7 days.
codex_note: Server-reported usage windows, with their independent reset times.
state_error: Could not read local data. Reopen to retry.
refresh_backoff: Please retry shortly. Repeated requests are limited and cached data is preserved.
refresh_hidden: Automatic refresh is paused. Select Refresh to read your account allowance.
error_cached: Refresh failed; showing the previous snapshot.
heatmap_scroll_hint: Scroll sideways for the full year · Arrow keys move between days
distribution_scope: All timestamped messages, grouped by local time. Records with totals only are excluded.
rf_signal_none: Public signals: no clear reset signal
rf_signal_hint: Public signals: a hint was detected; reset unconfirmed
rf_signal_watch: Public signals: source reports an announcement; awaiting confirmation
rf_signal_expired: Public signals: announced window ended; reset unconfirmed
rf_note: Experimental forecast; does not confirm a reset of your own allowance.
rf_cache_error: Update failed. Showing cached data; automatic retry shortly.
rf_stale_note: Source data is out of date; refer to confirmed announcements.
refresh_login: Your session has expired. Open ChatGPT to sign in, then retry.
refresh_verify: ChatGPT requires verification. Open the site to complete it, then retry.
refresh_limited: Temporarily rate limited. Your last reading is preserved; retry later.
refresh_timeout: The request timed out. Your last reading is preserved; retry shortly.
refresh_network: Unable to reach ChatGPT. Check your connection and retry.
refresh_invalid: The server response was not recognized. Your last reading is preserved.
refresh_current: Just updated. Your current reading is up to date.
column_hint: Hover, select or use arrow keys for exact counts
u_correct_pro_note: Only use this if the automatic reading is wrong. This manual correction stays inside Advanced.
pro_learned: Estimated from learned reset cycle + local sends.
pro_observed_learning: Confirmed local Pro sends only · learning reset cycle automatically.
pro_waiting_metadata: Tracking Pro sends · waiting for reset metadata
rn_note: Predictive reminders. Low sensitivity: fewer notifications, stronger signals. Thresholds are experimental, not a verified success rate.
pro_observed_pending: Allowance pending confirmation · locally recorded Pro sends only.
pro_account_limits: Uses your account’s reported allowance; no fixed message quota is assumed.
